name: Exterior Foundation RP Condition Assessment
intent: 4-point assessment: visual condition, chalk/adhesion test, moisture (MC <= 4% hard stop), grade-line gap check for incorrect caulking.
doctrine: Foundation RP 4-point assessment. MC <= 4% hard stop (stricter than masonry wall). Grade-line gap check: flag if previously caulked (drainage plane violation). No RRP — foundation coating is modern practice.
